name: Airbyte
long_description: Airbyte is the open-source data integration and ELT platform that makes your data ready for AI. 700+ connectors move data from any source into your warehouse, lake, or database. The same connectors now give AI agents governed access to that data through Airbyte’s MCP server, so your warehouse becomes your agents’ context layer. Run fully managed in Airbyte Cloud, self-host the open-source version, or go hybrid: we manage the control plane, your data never leaves your environment. Trusted by 20% of the Fortune 500 and over 40,000 companies worldwide.
one_liner: The open standard in data connectivity for AI and analytics.
